notes: Questions are in English because Jev's accuracy on CJK text is lower (docs.typesafe.ai/models). Chinese fields are display only. Every question asks about evidence PRESENT in `news`; none asks Jev to forecast. Arithmetic, dates and thresholds stay in code.

relevance_filter.instructions: Is `item` about NVIDIA's products, customers, suppliers, competitors' chips, hyperscalers' data-center spending plans, or regulators acting on NVIDIA?

criteria.true: The item mentions NVIDIA, or a customer's or competitor's choice of AI accelerators, or TSMC/HBM supply, or a hyperscaler's (Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta) capital-expenditure plan, or antitrust or export rules that touch NVIDIA
criteria.false: The item is about an unrelated company, general market moves, or macro news with no link to NVIDIA

claims.zh: 沒有前沿實驗室公開把旗艦模型訓練移出 NVIDIA

jev.instructions: Based only on `news`, has a frontier AI lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, xAI) publicly stated that it trains, or will train, its flagship foundation model primarily on non-NVIDIA accelerators?

criteria.broken: A named frontier lab, or a credible report citing it, says flagship model TRAINING runs or will run primarily on TPU, Trainium, AMD, or another non-NVIDIA chip
criteria.holds: A named frontier lab says or is reported to keep NVIDIA as its primary training platform, or a report explicitly says a switch to another chip is only for inference or for smaller models
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` says nothing about which chips a frontier lab uses to train its flagship model

claims.zh: AMD MI450 在 Anthropic／Meta 只用於推論

jev.instructions: Does `news` state that the AMD MI450 clusters ordered by Anthropic or Meta will be used to TRAIN models, rather than only to serve (inference) them?

criteria.broken: Anthropic, Meta, AMD, or a credible report says MI450 clusters will be used for model training
criteria.holds: The MI450 deployment is described as inference-only or serving-only
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` does not describe what the MI450 clusters are used for

claims.zh: 漲價後兩季毛利率回到 72% 以上

jev.instructions: Does `news` contain a statement from NVIDIA about the price increase it planned for the next fiscal year?

criteria.broken: NVIDIA says the planned price increase is cancelled, postponed, or smaller than previously stated
criteria.holds: NVIDIA confirms the price increase is going ahead or has taken effect
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` does not mention NVIDIA's pricing plans

claims.zh: 2027 年 CoWoS 配額仍過半

jev.instructions: Does `news` report that a competitor of NVIDIA (AMD, Broadcom, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, or Meta) has secured TSMC CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity or HBM memory supply for 2027?

criteria.broken: A competitor is reported to have secured 2027 CoWoS or HBM supply described as comparable to or larger than NVIDIA's
criteria.holds: A report says NVIDIA keeps the majority of 2027 CoWoS or HBM supply
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` does not discuss CoWoS or HBM allocation

claims.zh: 第三方估 AI 加速器份額不跌破 60%

jev.instructions: If `news` cites a market-research estimate of NVIDIA's share of AI accelerator revenue, which range does the cited number fall in?

criteria.below_60_percent: The cited NVIDIA share is below 60 percent
criteria.60_to_75_percent: The cited NVIDIA share is between 60 and 75 percent
criteria.above_75_percent: The cited NVIDIA share is above 75 percent
criteria.not_stated: `news` cites no market-share estimate for NVIDIA

claims.zh: 網路業務增速高於資料中心整體
Rubin Ultra 量產不延誤超過六個月

jev.instructions: Does `news` report a change to the production or shipment schedule of NVIDIA's Rubin Ultra platform?

criteria.broken: NVIDIA or a supply-chain source says Rubin Ultra production or shipments are delayed
criteria.holds: NVIDIA or a supply-chain source says Rubin Ultra is on schedule or ahead of schedule
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` does not mention the Rubin Ultra schedule

claims.zh: 沒有監管機關下令 NVIDIA 拆解交易或解綁產品

jev.instructions: Based only on `news`, what is the status of antitrust or regulatory action against NVIDIA's deals or product bundling by the U.S. DOJ or FTC, the European Commission, or China's SAMR?

criteria.broken: A regulator or court has ordered NVIDIA to unwind a deal, pay a fine, or unbundle products such as CUDA, NVLink, networking, or the Groq license
criteria.under_investigation: A regulator has opened or widened an investigation, issued subpoenas, or found that NVIDIA broke the law, but no fine or remedy has been ordered yet
criteria.holds: A regulator has closed its review of NVIDIA without any action
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` says nothing about regulatory action against NVIDIA

claims.zh: FY28 共識 EPS 兩季內不下修超過 10%

rule.note: baseline = FY28 consensus on 2026-09-22; threshold = baseline x 0.9

claims.zh: 11 月財報資料中心營收年增高於 60%
11 月財報 EPS 高於共識
下季財測高於共識

jev.instructions: Does `news` state how NVIDIA's revenue guidance for the next quarter compared with the analyst consensus at the time?

criteria.above_consensus: Guidance is described as above, ahead of, or beating consensus or expectations
criteria.in_line_or_below: Guidance is described as in line with, matching, below, or missing consensus or expectations
criteria.not_stated: `news` does not compare NVIDIA's guidance with consensus

claims.zh: 30 天分析師上修多於下修
四大 hyperscaler 2027 資本支出指引合計年增不低於 20%

jev.instructions: Does `news` report a change to the 2027 capital-expenditure plan of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, or Meta?

criteria.cut: A named hyperscaler lowered its 2027 capital-expenditure plan or guidance
criteria.raised_or_maintained: A named hyperscaler raised or reaffirmed its 2027 capital-expenditure plan or guidance
criteria.not_stated: `news` does not mention a hyperscaler's 2027 capital-expenditure plan

claims.zh: 供應承諾不被下修

jev.instructions: Does `news` state that NVIDIA changed the size of its total supply or purchase commitments?

criteria.broken: NVIDIA's supply or purchase commitments are reported as reduced from the prior quarter
criteria.holds: NVIDIA's supply or purchase commitments are reported as unchanged or increased
criteria.no_relevant_evidence: `news` does not mention NVIDIA's supply or purchase commitments

claims.zh: FCF 利潤率維持 35% 以上
LTM ROIC 不跌破 50%
應收帳款天數不拉長超過 15 天
股票薪酬占營收低於 5%

jev.instructions: Does `news` give a figure for how much of NVIDIA's investment in a customer (such as OpenAI or Anthropic) comes back to NVIDIA as purchases of NVIDIA chips?

criteria.true: A dollar amount or percentage of the investment that returns to NVIDIA as chip purchases is stated
criteria.false: No such figure is stated, even if the investment itself is mentioned

claims.zh: 單季庫存減損不超過 20 億美元
現價隱含 FY28 EPS 低於共識

rule.note: tree says 60 straight days; only the point value is available, so this uses the current 3-month comparison

收盤未跌破 211

jev.instructions: Does `news` report an armed conflict, blockade, or quarantine involving Taiwan that has halted TSMC production or that TSMC says will halt its production?

criteria.true: Such an event is reported as having happened
criteria.false: No such event is reported; military exercises, warnings, or analyst scenarios alone count as no

claims.zh: 反壟斷正式裁罰要求解綁

jev.instructions: Does `news` report that a regulator (U.S. DOJ, European Commission, or China's SAMR) has issued a formal ruling, fine, or remedy order against NVIDIA that requires it to unbundle CUDA, NVLink, or networking products?

criteria.true: A formal ruling, fine, or remedy order is reported
criteria.false: Only an investigation, complaint, or hearing is reported, or nothing at all

claims.zh: 新出口管制關掉現有市場

jev.instructions: Does `news` report a new U.S. export-control rule that bars NVIDIA from selling data-center accelerators to a country or customer group it currently sells to?

criteria.true: A new rule taking effect is reported
criteria.false: Only proposals, discussions, or rules already in force are reported, or nothing at all

claims.zh: 兩家以上 hyperscaler 下修 2027 資本支出

rule.note: risk: 'true' means the bad event happened

claims.zh: 主要客戶違約或客戶投資減損

jev.instructions: Does `news` report that a major NVIDIA customer missed a payment or defaulted, or that NVIDIA wrote down the value of an investment in a customer?

criteria.true: A missed payment, default, or write-down is reported
criteria.false: Only concerns, downgrades, or analyst warnings are reported, or nothing at all

claims.zh: 執行長離任

jev.instructions: Does `news` report that Jensen Huang is stepping down as CEO of NVIDIA or has been replaced?

criteria.true: A departure or replacement is reported

cleaning._comment: 2026-09-22: added by the evidence layer (scripts/jev/fetch_evidence.py, clean_evidence.py). Not part of the claim tree; used to tag each incoming news item before importance is computed in code. `item` is replaced with `items[i]` the same way relevance_filter is, above.

topic.instructions: Which one topic does `item` mostly concern?

criteria.customer_lock_in: The item is about a customer's or partner's commitment, investment, deal structure, or exclusivity with NVIDIA or a competitor — how tied a customer is to one supplier
criteria.supply_and_capacity: The item is about chip manufacturing capacity, TSMC CoWoS or HBM allocation, production yields, or supply-chain constraints
criteria.pricing_and_margin: The item is about NVIDIA's or a competitor's product pricing, price increases or cuts, or gross margin
criteria.regulation_and_export: The item is about a regulator, court, antitrust action, or export-control rule affecting NVIDIA or its chips
criteria.competitor_move: The item is about a competing chipmaker's (AMD, Broadcom, Google, Intel, or a custom ASIC) product, deal, or market share, with no NVIDIA pricing or supply angle
criteria.demand_and_capex: The item is about a customer's or hyperscaler's AI spending plan, capital-expenditure guidance, or data-center buildout
criteria.management_and_governance: The item is about NVIDIA's executives, board, or corporate governance
criteria.other: None of the above topics fit, or the item is general market commentary with no specific topic

kind.instructions: What kind of source or statement produced `item`?

criteria.dated_company_statement: A company (NVIDIA, a customer, a supplier, or a competitor) making a statement, in its own name, about something it did, is doing, or has decided — a press release, earnings statement, executive quote, or company blog post
criteria.dated_third_party_report: A named news outlet or wire service reporting a specific fact, event, or figure, often citing sources, without an accompanying buy or sell opinion
criteria.regulator_or_court_action: A regulator (such as the DOJ, SAMR, or the European Commission) or a court taking or announcing an action, ruling, filing, or investigation
criteria.analyst_opinion: A sell-side analyst's or research firm's rating, price target, or opinion about a stock
criteria.market_commentary_or_price_move: General commentary about a stock's price movement, a 'stocks to watch' style article, or macro or market commentary with no specific NVIDIA-related fact
criteria.other: None of the above kinds fit
